title: Beyond Alignment: Value Diversity as a Collective Property in Multicultural Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.05985v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multicultural multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed in globally diverse settings, where different agents are grounded in different cultural backgrounds. Existing cultural evaluation focuses on value alignment: how closely a single agent matches a target culture. Yet alignment is a per-agent property and cannot reveal whether a system, taken as a whole, preserves the cultural plurality it is meant to represent. We propose value diversity as a system-level evaluation axis for multicultural agent systems, defined through the dissimilarity between culturally conditioned agents' responses on a shared value survey. Using the World Values Survey, we evaluate 19 cultures and 18 backbone models across a wide range of system configurations. We find that diversity is largely uncorrelated with alignment, indicating that the two capture complementary system properties, and that current multicultural agent systems fall substantially below

translated_title: 超越对齐：作为多文化智能体系统中集体属性的价值多样性
translated_abstract: 多文化多智能体系统正日益被部署于全球化多元环境中，其中不同的智能体植根于不同的文化背景。现有的文化评估聚焦于价值对齐：即单个智能体与目标文化的匹配程度。然而，对齐是一种针对单个智能体的属性，无法揭示一个系统作为一个整体是否保留了它本应代表的文化多元性。我们提出将价值多样性作为多文化智能体系统的系统级评估维度，其定义为文化条件化的智能体在共享价值观调查中回答之间的差异程度。利用世界价值观调查，我们在广泛的系统配置下评估了19种文化和18个骨干模型。我们发现，多样性在很大程度上与对齐不相关，表明二者捕捉的是互补的系统属性，并且当前的多文化智能体系统的多样性大幅低于（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将“价值多样性”作为多文化智能体系统的全新系统级评估维度，发现其与传统的单智能体价值对齐基本不相关且二者互补，并揭示当前多文化智能体系统的价值多样性显著偏低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes value diversity as a new system-level evaluation axis for multicultural agent systems—measured by dissimilarity in culturally conditioned agents' responses on the World Values Survey—and shows it is largely uncorrelated with per-agent value alignment, while current multicultural agent systems exhibit substantially reduced diversity.
